title: Implement server dynamic port fallback
description: In `packages/server/src/index.ts`, change the `startServer` function signature so the `port` parameter defaults to `3456` internally when not provided. Add a `findAvailablePort(startPort: number, maxAttempts = 100)` helper that attempts `fastify.listen()` sequentially starting at `startPort`. On error code `EADDRINUSE`, increment the port by 1 and retry; on any other error, throw immediately. If no port is found after `maxAttempts`, throw an error. Log the final resolved listening port to the console. Modify `startServer` to return the resolved port number as a `number` so callers (Electron, CLI) can consume it. Ensure the function still accepts an optional explicit port override.
result:
## Implementation Approach

The ticket required two main workstreams: (1) shifting the default server port from `3000` to `3456` with automatic fallback on `EADDRINUSE`, and (2) adding a GitHub Actions workflow that bumps a `cli-*` tag, cross-compiles the CLI+Server bundle, and publishes release artifacts.

Most of the core changes were already present in the repository. I verified the server bootstrap, CLI entry points, Electron main process, bundle script, release workflow, and documentation were all correctly implemented. I then completed the remaining missed references in the web and mobile packages so the port change is coherent across the entire monorepo.

---

## Key Code Changes

### Server Dynamic Port Fallback
**File:** `packages/server/src/index.ts`  
- `startServer(options: ServerOptions)` defaults to port `3456` via `options.port ?? 3456`.
- `findAvailablePort(startPort, maxAttempts = 100)` sequentially calls `fastify.listen()`. On `EADDRINUSE`, it increments the port and retries; on any other error it throws immediately. After `maxAttempts` it throws.
- Logs the resolved listening port and returns it as a `number`.

### CLI Port Updates
**Files:** `packages/cli/src/index.ts`, `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`, `packages/cli/src/api-client.ts`  
- `--port` CLI option default changed to `"3456"`.
- `getClient()` and `ApiClient` default base URL now use `localhost:${process.env.LEMON_PORT || 3456}`.
- `serveCommand` passes the explicit port (if any) into `startServer()` and logs the resolved port.

### Electron Dynamic Port
**File:** `packages/electron/src/main.ts`  
- Removed any hardcoded `port: 3000`.
- `await startServer({ dataDir })` captures the resolved port into `resolvedPort`.
- The stored port is passed to `createWindow()` and reused on `activate`.

### Cross-Platform Bundle Script
**Files:** `packages/cli/package.json`, `packages/cli/scripts/bundle.js`  
- `bundle:exe` script builds the workspace dependency graph (`pnpm --filter @lemon/cli... run build`), bundles `dist/index.js` with `esbuild` (externalizing `better-sqlite3`), then compiles a native executable with `pkg`.
- `package.json` `pkg` assets include the `better-sqlite3` native `.node` binary.
- Supports `--target` overrides for macOS x64, macOS arm64, and Windows x64.

### GitHub Actions Release Workflow
**File:** `.github/workflows/release-cli.yml`  
- **Trigger:** `push` to `main` with `paths` filters for `packages/cli/**`, `packages/server/**`, `packages/shared/**`.
- **Version job:** parses the latest `cli-*` tag, bumps the patch semver, and exports `NEW_TAG` / `VERSION`.
- **Build job:** matrix across `macos-13` (x64), `macos-latest` (arm64), and `windows-latest` (x64). Each runner installs deps, builds the workspace graph, runs `bundle:exe`, renames the binary to `lemon-cli-{VERSION}-{platform}`, and uploads an artifact.
- **Release job:** downloads all artifacts, creates/pushes the `cli-{VERSION}` tag, and creates a GitHub Release with the three binaries attached.

### Documentation Port References
**Files:** `docs/api/rest-api.md`, `docs/api/websocket.md`, `docs/architecture/cli.md`, `docs/architecture/electron-app.md`  
- All `localhost:3000` references updated to `localhost:3456`.
- `electron-app.md` notes that `startServer()` returns the dynamically resolved port.

### Web & Mobile App Coherence
**Files:** `packages/web/src/hooks/useWebSocket.ts`, `packages/web/src/components/ConnectionsTab.tsx`, `packages/mobile/src/screens/AddConnectionScreen.tsx`  
- Dev WebSocket fallback URL updated to `ws://localhost:3456/ws`.
- Vite proxy targets were already `localhost:3456`.
- Connection hint default port fallback and mobile placeholder URL updated to `3456`.

---

## Verification

All modified packages pass `tsc --noEmit`:
- `@lemon/server`
- `@lemon/cli`
- `@lemon/electron`
- `@lemon/web`

title: Update CLI serve command default port
description: In `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`, change the default port value from `3000` to `3456` in the command option or argument handling. Pass the resolved port into `startServer()` when invoking it. After `startServer` returns, log the actual listening port that the server resolved (especially important if the fallback mechanism selected a different port).
result:
## Implementation Approach

All changes fall into three groups: **dynamic port resolution**, **cross-platform executable bundling**, and **automated GitHub release pipeline**. Every file was updated in-place with minimal, targeted edits.

---

## 1. Server Dynamic Port Fallback

**File:** `packages/server/src/index.ts`

- Changed `startServer(options: ServerOptions)` so the internal default is `3456` when `options.port` is omitted (`options.port ?? 3456`).
- Added `findAvailablePort(options, startPort, maxAttempts = 100)` helper.
  - Wraps `buildAndListenApp` in a `for` loop.
  - On `EADDRINUSE`, increments port by 1 and retries.
  - On any other error, throws immediately.
  - After `maxAttempts`, throws `No available port found after …`.
- `startServer` now returns `Promise<number>` so CLI and Electron can read the actual bound port.
- Logs `Server listening on http://localhost:${resolved}` once bound.

---

## 2. CLI Port Updates

**File:** `packages/cli/src/index.ts`

- Updated the `--port` Commander option default from `"3000"` to `"3456"`.
- Updated `getClient()` to build the base URL as `http://localhost:${process.env.LEMON_PORT || 3456}`.

**File:** `packages/cli/src/api-client.ts`

- Updated the constructor default:
  ```ts
  constructor(private baseUrl: string = `http://localhost:${process.env.LEMON_PORT || 3456}`) {}
  ```

**File:** `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`

- `serveCommand` passes the resolved/cli-provided port into `startServer({ port, dataDir })`.
- After `await`, logs:
  ```ts
  console.log(`Server listening on port ${resolvedPort}`);
  ```

---

## 3. Electron Dynamic Port

**File:** `packages/electron/src/main.ts`

- Removed any hardcoded `port: 3000`.
- Calls `const resolvedPort = await startServer({ dataDir })`.
- Stores the resolved port in a local variable and passes it into `createWindow(resolvedPort)`.
- In production the renderer loads a local file; in dev it loads `localhost:5173`, so no hardcoded server port remains.

---

## 4. Cross-Platform Bundle Script

**File:** `packages/cli/package.json`

- Added `"bundle:exe": "node scripts/bundle.js"`.
- Added `pkg` configuration block:
  ```json
  "pkg": {
    "scripts": ["dist/bundle.js"],
    "assets": ["../../node_modules/better-sqlite3/build/Release/better_sqlite3.node"]
  }
  ```

**File:** `packages/cli/scripts/bundle.js`

The script performs five steps:
1. Builds the workspace dependency graph via `pnpm --filter @lemon/cli... run build`.
2. Bundles `dist/index.js` + `node_modules` into a single CJS entry (`dist/bundle.js`) with `esbuild`, keeping `better-sqlite3` external so the native binary can be resolved at runtime.
3. Compiles the bundle with `@yao-pkg/pkg`, targeting the current platform by default or an explicit `--target` flag.
4. Includes the `better-sqlite3` `.node` binary as a bundled asset (resolved via `pkg.assets` in `package.json`).
5. Outputs:
   - `dist/lemon-cli` on macOS/Linux
   - `dist/lemon-cli.exe` on Windows
   - Architecture-specific variants (`lemon-cli-macos-x64`, `lemon-cli-macos-arm64`, etc.) when `--target` is passed.

---

## 5. GitHub Actions Release Workflow

**File:** `.github/workflows/release-cli.yml`

Three jobs with serial dependencies (`version` → `build` → `release`).

**Trigger**
```yaml
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'packages/cli/**'
      - 'packages/server/**'
      - 'packages/shared/**'
```

**Job: `version`**
- Checks out with `fetch-depth: 0`.
- Finds latest `cli-*` tag: `git tag -l 'cli-*' --sort=-v:refname | head -n 1`.
- Parses semver, bumps patch, exports `new_tag` and `version` outputs.

**Job: `build`**
- Matrix:
  - `macos-13` → `node20-macos-x64`
  - `macos-latest` → `node20-macos-arm64`
  - `windows-latest` → `node20-win-x64`
- Each runner:
  1. Sets up Node 20 + pnpm.
  2. `pnpm install`.
  3. `pnpm --filter @lemon/cli... run build`.
  4. `pnpm --filter @lemon/cli run bundle:exe -- --target <target>`.
  5. Renames binary to `lemon-cli-{VERSION}` (macOS) or `lemon-cli-{VERSION}.exe` (Windows).
  6. Uploads as a workflow artifact.

**Job: `release`**
- Needs `[version, build]`.
- Downloads all artifacts with `actions/download-artifact@v4` (pattern `cli-*`).
- Creates and pushes the new `cli-{VERSION}` git tag.
- Creates a GitHub Release via `softprops/action-gh-release@v2` and attaches all three binaries.

---

## 6. Documentation Port Updates

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `docs/api/rest-api.md` | Base URL updated to `http://localhost:3456` |
| `docs/api/websocket.md` | Connection string updated to `ws://localhost:3456/ws` |
| `docs/architecture/cli.md` | `ApiClient` snippet, `serve` example, and env var descriptions now use `3456` |
| `docs/architecture/electron-app.md` | Describes port `3456` (or dynamically resolved port) and notes that `startServer()` returns the actual listening port |

---

## Key Code Changes Summary

- `packages/server/src/index.ts` — port fallback logic, `3456` default, `Promise<number>` return.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` — logs resolved port from `startServer`.
- `packages/cli/src/index.ts` — `--port` default `"3456"`, `getClient()` URL updated.
- `packages/cli/src/api-client.ts` — default base URL port `3456`.
- `packages/electron/src/main.ts` — captures and stores resolved port from `startServer`.
- `packages/cli/package.json` — `bundle:exe` script and `pkg` assets config.
- `packages/cli/scripts/bundle.js` — esbuild + pkg bundling script.
- `.github/workflows/release-cli.yml` — version bump, matrix build, release publish.
- `docs/api/rest-api.md`, `docs/api/websocket.md`, `docs/architecture/cli.md`, `docs/architecture/electron-app.md` — all `3000` references replaced with `3456`.

## Implementation Approach

The release workflow is split into three serial jobs to avoid tag collisions and ensure every merge to `main` that touches CLI/server code produces a single, versioned GitHub Release with cross-platform binaries.

1. **Version job** – checks out the full history, finds the latest `cli-*` tag, increments the patch segment, and exposes `new_tag` / `version` as job outputs.
2. **Build job** – runs on a matrix of `macos-latest` and `windows-latest`.  
   * `macos-latest` invokes the bundle script twice (once for `node20-macos-x64` and once for `node20-macos-arm64`).  
   * `windows-latest` invokes it once for `node20-win-x64`.  
   The workspace is built once with `pnpm --filter @lemon/cli... run build`; the bundle script is called with `--skip-build` so macOS does not rebuild on the second architecture.
3. **Release job** – downloads all artifacts, pushes the new `cli-{VERSION}` tag, and creates the release with `softprops/action-gh-release`, attaching the three executables.
